data.body: Superseded by epic compliant-lemon-grunion (759e-7dc1-675c-4877). Its intent — replaying historical tickets through plan review as a regression oracle — is delivered by that epic's three replay tiers over the REVIEW_RESULT sidecar corpus. The specific mechanism proposed here (mocking LLM calls from recorded live responses) is infeasible: rebar never persists prompts or raw responses (only parse-failure artifacts), so there is nothing to record from. The sidecars do persist Pass-1 findings, Pass-2 answer vectors and Pass-3 outputs, which is what the new harness replays.
